title: Telemetry-driven retry floor and idempotency-hint propagation for multi-lang SDKs
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: SDK users across Python/TypeScript/Go need safer, lower-cost defaults for retries and idempotency that adapt to real traffic characteristics. Current advice documents static backoff and idempotency windows which either cause excess duplicate requests (aggressive retries) or poor availability (overly conservative).

Goal: Provide a cross-SDK implementation and config surface that: (1) uses lightweight telemetry signals to compute a conservative "retry floor" per client session and per route, (2) propagates sampled idempotency hints and rotation metadata through retries and during streaming resume, and (3) exposes a small set of ergonomically-named presets (e.g., conservative, balanced, aggressive) with deterministic, cross-language semantics.

Scope: Design and implement client-side defaults and helper utilities in Python/TS/Go SDKs covering: retry/backoff presets, session-bounded retry budgets, sampled idempotency-hint propagation (opaque id + rotation metadata), streaming resume id-key semantics, telemetry hooks (counters/histograms) and migration guide for customers currently using manual retries.

Out of scope: Server-side retry orchestration and SLO changes; deep instrumentation of backend components (we rely on existing agent telemetry).
approach: Define a small cross-sdk enum for RetryPreset = {conservative, balanced, aggressive} with fixed parameters documented in README.

Implement a session-level RetryFloorCalculator that observes request latency percentiles and error rates (sampled) to compute a minimum backoff multiplier and a session retry budget (tokens per minute).

Create an IdempotencyHint object (opaque id string, rotate_after_ms, sampled boolean) and propagate it in retry envelopes and stream-resume headers. Rotation metadata must be idempotent-safe and documented for servers.

Add 'telemetry hooks' interface to each SDK for recording: attempted_retries, dedup_detections, id_rotation_count, stream_resume_attempts. Default implementation increments lightweight counters and emits histograms to existing agent bridge.
Provide examples and migration guide for chunked upload, long-poll chat streaming, and short generation requests, including code snippets for Python/TS/Go.
Run cross-language interop tests that validate duplicate suppression at server side when idempotency hints match and rotation semantics are correct.
acceptance_criteria: SDKs (py/ts/go) implement RetryPreset API with identical presets and clear parameter tables in README.
Session-level retry floor calculation enabled by default for 'balanced' preset and disabled via explicit option.
Opaque IdempotencyHint object serializes into request headers and is accepted/respected by test server harness; server dedup behavior validated in end-to-end test.
Streaming resume includes stable resume-id header and supports id rotation metadata; resume behavior covered by integration tests that simulate reconnects.
Telemetry counters appear in internal dashboards with labels: sdk_language, route, preset, session_id; basic dashboard created at /dashboards/sdk/retries/telemetry-floor.
Migration doc published with examples for disabling SDK-driven retries and mapping old idempotency keys to new serialized hint format.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Telemetry sampling could bias RetryFloorCalculator on low-traffic clients. Mitigation: fall back to safe static floor for sessions under minimum-sample-threshold (configurable).
Risk: Opaque id metadata may leak PII if apps embed user identifiers. Mitigation: document best practice to hash/salt any app-level data and provide example helper in SDKs.
Risk: Different language runtimes serialize rotation metadata differently. Mitigation: canonicalize header format (base64-encoded JSON) and include cross-sdk parsing tests.
progress_updates: 2026-02-19: Kickoff design sync with SDK leads (Maya, Ethan, Lina). Agreed on three-presets approach and session-bounded budget idea.
2026-02-23: Prototype of RetryFloorCalculator in Python using p50/p95 latency windows; initial tests reduced duplicate retries by ~22% in synthetic workload.
2026-03-02: Finalized IdempotencyHint wire format: header 'X-RW-Idemp: base64(json:{"id":...,"r":ms,"s":bool})' and rotation semantics doc published.
2026-03-05: Cross-SDK API surface reviewed; minor ergonomic tweaks for Go (context-based) and TS (Promise-based override).
2026-03-09: Telemetry dashboard skeleton created (PR to observability repo). Sampled counters visible for internal test cluster.
2026-03-12: Linked PRs opened for Python/TS/Go; integration tests failing due to header size limit on legacy ingress — investigating compression or alternate header strategy.
test_plan: Unit tests for RetryFloorCalculator behavior under synthetic latency/error traces.
E2E tests with server harness that verifies dedup suppression when IdempotencyHint matches and correct behavior when rotation occurs.
Streaming resume fuzz tests that simulate intermittent disconnects and ensure resume header restores correct state without duplication.
Performance microbenchmarks to ensure default telemetry hooks do not add >0.5% latency per request.
Canary release to internal 'beta' org before wider rollout.
notes: Implementation must be opt-out via client option to remain compatible with customers who run their own retry wrappers.
Consider a future feature: server-provided 'client_retry_advice' header to allow more aggressive client-side behavior when backend signals health.
Follow-up ticket recommended to add admin console toggles per-organization for SDK telemetry sampling rates.
